brief:
Political analyst Bilal al-Laqis told Shehab Wire that Israeli occupation forces are rejecting implementation of understandings while pursuing coordinated military and political strategies across Lebanon and Gaza. Al-Laqis, a researcher specializing in regional and Israeli affairs, said the approach in Lebanon tracks entirely with operations conducted in the Gaza Strip, suggesting an integrated campaign rather than separate regional conflicts.

The assessment reflects Palestinian concerns over Israeli conduct amid escalating regional tensions. Al-Laqis framed the rejection of agreements as part of a broader pattern of Israeli strategy that extends beyond any single theater of conflict. He did not specify which understandings Israel has allegedly refused to implement.

title: Israeli occupation refuses to implement agreements, analyst says
